About IFQM

The Indian Foundation for Quality Management (IFQM)

was founded in 2023 to catalyse transformational changes in the way Indian companies operate. This includes institutionalizing a culture of quality that meets and exceeds global standards, cutting across industry sectors and segments.

IFQM is committed to offer expertise and solutions that enable continuous improvements in products and services, aimed to enhance the respect for Brand India globally.

MISSION

Through the commitment of CEOs and Boards, we will:

  • Create the "Indian Way" to enhance customer and societal value through a systemic approach.
  • Propagate Quality and Innovation for sustainable growth.
  • Develop committed counsellors to train and coach organizations.
  • Accelerate learning and mutual sharing of best practices, leveraging the power of technology.

Past Symposiums – A Glimpse

Two successful editions.
One powerful journey.

The IFQM Symposium has established itself as India's premier platform for quality leadership, bringing together thought leaders, practitioners and change makers to learn, share and lead the path to excellence.

IFQM SYMPOSIUM 2025
18 September 2025
Taj Palace, New Delhi

IFQM Symposium 2025 brought senior quality leaders together at the Taj Palace, New Delhi, for a day of dialogue on quality leadership and business excellence.

~333Delegates (approx.)
67Speakers

Delegate count is approximate and includes invited guests, attendees and speakers.

IFQM MSME SYMPOSIUM 2026
20 March 2026
Anna University, Chennai

IFQM MSME Symposium 2026 convened delegates at Anna University, Chennai, to advance quality and operational excellence among India's MSME sector.
